transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Thanks for joining, Ravi. Could you start with what you need from us?

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: Sure - Ravi Menon, I lead platform engineering at Beta. My job is to make sure anything we roll out fits our identity and data setup.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: I think SSO is the main open item from our side.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: We'll need SAML SSO against our Okta tenant for all 140 agents.

transcript.speaker: speaker_04
transcript.text: We support SAML with Okta today, including SCIM provisioning.

transcript.speaker: speaker_05
transcript.text: From the support side, the Dublin agents handle every EU customer ticket.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: Good. I'll also want to understand the data flows for the Dublin team before I sign off.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Understood. We'll follow up with whatever documentation you need.
